## Experience

- SAP iXp Intern, Process Value Analysis @ SAP Labs Berlin — 04/2026–Present. React/TypeScript micro-frontend for SAP Signavio (GraphQL/Apollo, Module Federation v2); shipped Export Value Cases to production with Vitest + Cypress in CI.
- Student Research Assistant @ Hasso Plattner Institute, Digital Health Center — 05/2024–04/2026. Built StudyU features and StudyU AI (FastAPI, PydanticAI, React).
- Co-Founder & CTO @ Gatsot — 09/2024–Present. Cyprus grocery price-comparison platform; €30K pre-seed, 5,500+ users, 18,000+ processed receipts.
- Software Engineer @ Niyel Technologies LTD — 10/2021–09/2023. Offline-first Flutter mobile ERP for Odoo workflows.

## Featured projects

- [Gatsot](https://gatsot.app) — Turkish/Cypriot grocery price-comparison app (Flutter + Laravel + OCR/LLM).
- StudyU AI — full-stack AI assistant for N-of-1 study design (FastAPI, PydanticAI, React, PubMed-grounded MCP tool).
- SAP Signavio Export Value Cases — production React/TypeScript feature in a micro-frontend with GraphQL/Apollo and Module Federation v2.

## Publications

- NOF1-BCD: A Framework for Causal Estimates with N-of-1 Bayesian Digital Twins — SD4H Workshop, ICML 2026 (Poster).
- [Personalization of Large Foundation Models for Health Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03482) — AAAI 2026 PerFM Workshop, arXiv:2601.03482.
